title: NorthStar Invention Forge MK1–MK55: Parametric CAD, KiCad Schematic Architecture, and Theoretical Applied Physics Derivations
description: This compendium packages the theoretical engineering derivations, ISO-10303-21 STEP solid-model geometries, KiCad 8.0 schematic netlists, and bills of materials across the NorthStar Invention Forge series (MK1 through MK55), accompanied by our automated structural verifier (engineering_integrity.py).
